Needs changes before merge.

The display uses the shared height resolver. The new tests cover plane corners, labels, draft edits, and invalid angles. The decision records and the `Changelog:` line are present.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The diff against main includes the generation changes from the older parent head `3e62cea0a`.

I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2429` against upstream main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`. The head already contains that main commit. The trial merge reports `Already up to date`. No GitHub runner was used.

Build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 253 steps passed; 3,186 tests passed; 27 ignored; zero failures |
| App library tests, included above | 362 passed; 1 ignored |
| UI library tests, included above; run from `crates/ui` | 1,060 passed; 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Temporary tests from the newer parent, on this PR's production code | 3 passed; 5 failed; details below |
| Original app `tilt_heights`, after removal of the temporary tests | 3 passed |
| UI `egui_app::heights_tests`, after restoration of both mutations | 12 passed |

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:

- Restore `resolve_height` inside `region_z`: `tilted_height_region_level_uses_the_same_fold` fails. The result is 10 instead of 14.
- Remove `- f.origin.z` from plane placement: `tilted_height_planes_use_tool_axis_and_local_stock_corners` fails. The local clearance is 24 instead of 21.

Both mutations compiled. Each failed its named assertion. I restored both files. The original tests then passed. No golden, NC, CL, or snapshot PNG file changed, so there were no moved goldens to inspect.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs:223`, with `crates/app/src/operation/area.rs:172` and `:220`: include the parent fixes for the pocket island planes. Generation uses `resolve_params_folded`, but both island ladders still use setup-Z heights. I copied the newer parent's two pocket tests into the local review tree. Both fail on this head, with 16 `Gouge` warnings each. The fixture uses stock 40 x 40 x 50, part bounds (-10,-5,-15) to (10,5,15), and A90. Top is Top of stock; Bottom is Top of model minus 2. This affects both whole-model and Stock sources. Verification detects the gouges; this is not evidence that unsafe G-code passes the post gate. Parent #2418 head `302b097254569c239d5d5e3f28ff06625080b92c` contains the fixes and tests. Include those fixes in this stack before merge, and run the tests again.

2. `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs:223`, with `crates/app/src/operation/heights_sel.rs:168`: include the parent fix for depth validation. `depth_sane` still calls `resolve_params`, while generation uses the tilted resolver. With stock Y -1..11, Z -20..10, A=-90, and origin zero, Top of stock is 11 along the tool axis. A Fixed bottom of 10.5 is legal. Creation and editing both reject it because validation reads Top as 10. The reverse height order also passes creation incorrectly. All three newer parent validation tests fail on this head. Use the checked tilt frame for validation, as the updated parent does.

   The legal creation and editing cases report:

   ```text
   Invalid("a Slot operation must cut downward: its top height resolves below its bottom height (check the From references)")
   ```

3. `crates/ui/src/height_display.rs:40` and `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:126`: cache the new geometry reads used by the display. `shell.rs:607` calls `overlay_labels` on each viewport frame. That calls `height_planes` and `plane_rect`. The tilted bounds transform all stock or model facets. Each model-based height also reads and projects the part facets through `fold_height`. The Heights rows repeat that read for their echoes. These paths have no cache for unchanged inputs. This violates upstream main's current UI **Frame cost** rule. Cache the local extents and resolved display values using the geometry, setup, and draft inputs. Add an unchanged-frame counter test and changed-input tests. Keep generation and safety checks independent of the display cache.

4. `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:1708` and the PR body: add before/after screenshots for the changed viewport planes and height text. The body has no screenshots. Show the tilted operation and the Heights tab, with readable axis values. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit them to this PR branch.

The temporary parent tests are removed. The review tree has no code changes. The PR remains a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Pocket island planes now use folded heights. Pins: `tilted_whole_model_reference_pocket_preserves_part_islands` and `tilted_stock_reference_pocket_preserves_part_islands`.
2. Depth validation now uses the checked tilt frame. Pins: `tilted_mixed_reference_depth_is_accepted_on_creation`, `tilted_mixed_reference_depth_is_accepted_on_editing`, and `tilted_upward_mixed_reference_depth_is_refused_on_creation_and_editing`.
3. Display bounds and heights now use a cache keyed by actual inputs. Seven `height_memo::tests` pins cover unchanged frames and changed inputs. `display_callers_fill_the_cache_then_reuse_their_geometry_reads` also checks each caller.
4. The PR body links before/after GPU screenshots of the tilted viewport and Heights rows. Images exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `2ae280f6002508d4b1a68bc50dfda042840583c5`.

All five new app pins fail with the old production code. All eight app height tests pass after restoration.
Three cache mutations compile and fail their assertions. All seven cache tests pass after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 253 steps, 3,198 tests passed, 27 ignored, zero failures.
App/UI all-targets clippy with `-D warnings` passed with zero warnings.

New head: `26f2162873f3fd882ea35f5c1c0cf609c51dc073`.
Please re-review this head.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The diff includes generation heights and pocket island checks.
I used the current rules from upstream main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`.

The four earlier findings are addressed:

- Both pocket island ladders use folded heights. Their regression tests pass.
- Depth validation uses the checked tilt frame. The three regression tests pass.
- The display cache retains bounds and resolved heights. All seven cache tests pass, including the unchanged-frame counter tests.
- The PR body links before/after screenshots. I opened both images. They show the tilted viewport and readable Heights rows.

Local build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge in `.claude/worktrees/review-2429` | Already up to date with upstream main |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 253 steps; 3,198 passed; 27 ignored; zero failures |
| App library tests, included above | 362 passed; 1 ignored |
| UI library tests, included above; run from `crates/ui` | 1,067 passed; 6 ignored |
| App/UI all-targets clippy with `-D warnings` | Passed |
| App `tilt_heights`, after mutation restoration | 8 passed |
| UI `egui_app::heights_tests`, after temporary test removal | 12 passed |
| Two temporary page tests for the remaining note defect | Both compiled and failed their assertions |

The gate took 23.5 minutes. The first attempt ended with exit code 143 during compilation and gave no verdict.
The second attempt completed. No GitHub runner was used.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:

1. Restore setup-Z heights in both pocket island ladders. Both island tests fail, with 16 `Gouge` warnings each.
2. Restore `resolve_params` in depth validation. All three mixed-reference validation tests fail.

Both mutations compiled. I restored each file. All eight app height tests then passed.
No NC, CL, golden, or snapshot PNG file changed. There were no moved goldens to inspect.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:145`, with `crates/ui/src/egui_app/heights_page.rs:63`: use the draft tilt and the shared folded resolver for the retract note. The updated row echo uses the tool axis, but `resolve_all` still reads setup Z. The note can contradict both the displayed heights and generation.

   I used the existing asymmetric pocket fixture: stock Y -1..11, Z -20..10, A=-90, origin (2,0,3). Clearance is Top of stock +10. Its row correctly shows 21 along the tool axis. With Fixed retract 23.5, the retract row shows 20.5. The page incorrectly says retract is above clearance. With Fixed retract 25.5, the hop must use clearance 21. The page instead prints:

   ```text
   above clearance - the hop travels at 20.000 (min of the two)
   ```

   Two temporary tests through the production Heights page confirmed these cases. Both failed after the row assertions passed. Pass the draft tilt into the note. Compare folded heights and print the local distance, as the rows do. Add tests for both cases. The shared `resolve_all` also supplies the corner note; keep that text in the same frame.

2. `crates/ui/src/height_memo.rs:102`: remove `expect("inserted entry")` from production code. The current upstream Prime Directive forbids `expect()` outside tests and cold unreachable arms. The preceding push appears to establish the invariant; this is a rule violation, not a reproduced panic. Apply the callback to a local entry before you return it to the cache, or use another form that has no panic path.

The temporary tests and mutations are removed. The review tree has no code changes.
The PR remains a draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The retract and corner notes now use the draft tilt and the shared folded height resolver. They show local tool-axis distances.
   Pins in `egui_app::heights_tests::notes`:
   - `tilted_retract_below_clearance_does_not_report_setup_z_order`
   - `tilted_retract_above_clearance_names_the_local_hop_height`
   - `retract_note_follows_an_unapplied_tilt_edit`
   - `tilted_corner_note_uses_the_same_local_frame_as_its_top_row`
2. The cache applies the callback to a local entry before it stores that entry. Production code has no `expect()` call.
   Pin: `height_memo::tests::display_cache_has_no_production_panic_path`.

Mutation checks compiled and failed their assertions. Restoring setup-Z resolution failed all four page pins. Removing draft tilt also failed all four page pins. Restoring the cache `expect()` failed its rule pin. After restoration, all 16 Heights tests and eight cache tests passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. 253 steps; 3,203 passed; 27 ignored; zero failures.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
The full gate used this worktree's assets after a shared build path selected the wrong assets on the first attempt.

New head: `071b797acdfd510e924378a7d53e2e05df1fb309`.
Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.
